ratings.notes: Empath relates to care; psychopath relates to lack of care and general immorality.
Haunted relates to suffering (Care vice); blissful relates to well-being (Care virtue).
Entitled can relate to unfairness and disrespect for authority; grateful relates to humility and acknowledging others (Purity, General).
Lover relates to peace (Care virtue); fighter relates to violence (Care vice).
Freak can relate to deviance from social norms (Purity, Authority).
Generous relates to kindness (Care) and equitable sharing (Fairness); stingy relates to lack of these and general immorality.
Stubborn can relate to defiance (Authority) or unwillingness to compromise (Fairness).
Two-faced relates to dishonesty (Fairness, Loyalty, Purity) and general immorality.
Chivalrous relates to protection (Care), honor/respect (Authority), and general virtue.
On-time can relate to respect for others' time and adherence to norms (Authority).
Everyman relates to equality (Fairness); chosen one relates to status/hierarchy (Authority).
